rules.statement: In an election case based on circumstantial evidence, the prosecution must prove beyond reasonable doubt that every element of the charge is established and exclude every reasonable hypothesis of innocence.
rules.supporting_quote: "In order to come within the principle of having to exclude every reasonable hypothesis of innocence in a case based upon circumstantial evidence, it is not necessary for an accused person to show that the circumstances giving rise to the hypothesis of innocence will go as far as to establish a prima facie case of that hypothesis. It is only necessary to show that such reasonable hypothesis cannot be excluded."
